PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Title: Pneuma's Combat Tools
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.NoEquippedWeapons: No available attacks in this category.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.TargetedRightClickNa: Open Combat Tools when right-clicking an owned target
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.TargetedRightClickHi: When enabled, right-clicking a targeted token you own opens Combat Tools instead of switching control to that token. Only affects you. Shift + right-click always shows only Combat Tools, whether you own the token or not.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.statusIconScaleHint: Size of the icons under Assign Status Effects, relative to the HUD size (1 = readable default). Does not resize conditions drawn on tokens.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.hudScaleHint: Your preferred Token HUD size (1 = normal). Controls and menu text stay this size when zooming. Non-1x1 token HUDs center on your right-click; 1x1 HUDs center on the token.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.TightHUDHint: Bring Token HUD columns and buttons closer together without reducing button size. Applies only to your client; updates an open HUD immediately.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.hoverDVEncounterOnly: Only show Hover DVs during active encounter
Show hover weapon DVs only while an encounter is active and started on the current scene. This preference applies to this client only.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.hoverDVName: Show equipped weapon DVs on hover
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.hoverDVHint: Select one owned token and hover over another visible token to see ranged weapon DVs, including installed weapon attachments and cyberweapons. Works inside and outside combat unless the active-encounter-only option is enabled. Disable the other hover DV display if also using Diwako's module.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.hoverAutofireHint: Add a separate Autofire line for each capable weapon. Applies only to your client.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.AttackFailed: Attack could not complete. Check the system notification or console before retrying.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.IconColorHint: GM setting for all players. Choose a color for the main Combat Tools icons. Clear the value to use amber (#ffc36a). Submenu icons, native Token HUD icons, and weapon images are unchanged.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionEligibilityHi: Choose RAW Ranged Evasion, disable ranged evasion, or configure Homebrew rules. Applied to defense choices on Combat Tools attack cards.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionReflexHint: Custom eligibility only. Requires current REF 8+, including applicable stat modifications such as drugs. Free grants share one allowance unless marked stacking; each stacking grant adds one. Allowance settings below determine whether free grants are used.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionCoprocessorNa: Ranged evasion: custom Reflex Co-Processor qualifier
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionCoprocessorHi: Custom eligibility only. Requires an installed, functional Reflex Co-Processor. Counts once, regardless of implant quantity. Non-stacking free grants share one allowance; stacking adds one.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionSoloName: Ranged evasion: custom Solo / Threat Detection qualifier
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionSoloHint: Custom eligibility only. Requires a Solo with at least 2 Combat Awareness points currently allocated to Threat Detection. Non-stacking free grants share one allowance; stacking adds one.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionQualifierElig: Qualifies only: grants no free evasion
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionQualifierFree: Qualifies + 1 free evasion per round (does not stack)
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionAllowanceHint: Eligibility is always required. RAW eligibility supplies one free allowance for the limited modes; custom eligibility uses its qualifier grants. Unlimited and pay-every-time modes ignore free grants. Count attempts, successful or not, per combat round, not per turn.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionUnlimited: RAW: unlimited; no required LUCK cost
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionLimited: Homebrew: free allowance only; no further evasions
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionLuckEach: Homebrew: pay LUCK for every evasion
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionLuckAfterAllo: Homebrew: free allowance, then pay LUCK for additional evasions
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionLuckCostName: Ranged evasion: LUCK cost per paid evasion
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionLuckCostHint: Positive whole LUCK points per paid evasion. Used only by the two paid modes. Insufficient LUCK prevents a paid attempt. LUCK is spent when a paid Combat Tools evasion is confirmed.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionFlatPenaltyHi: Adds -4 to every ranged Evasion check. Can combine with the cumulative penalty. Melee Evasion is unaffected. Not enforced yet.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionCumulativePen: Ranged evasion: cumulative -1 after the first (homebrew)
Penalty by ranged evasion attempt each round: 0, -1, -2, -3, including paid attempts. With the flat -4 option: -4, -5, -6, -7. Resets each combat round. Not enforced yet.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionCheckboxHint: Only satisfied qualifiers with Qualifies checked count. One Free Evasion grants one per round; non-stacking grants share one allowance, while each stacking grant adds one. Stacks has no effect without One Free Evasion.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionRuleLabel: Ranged Evasion Rule after free evasions
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionAfterFreeHint: Free evasions are used first each round. The selected rule applies once they are exhausted. Cumulative penalties start at -1, then -2, -3, and so on. With no free evasions, the rule applies from the first attempt.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.EvasionLuckInvalid: LUCK cost must be a positive whole number.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Name: Pneuma's Quickhack
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.Sour: The source token has no actor.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.Targ: The target token has no actor.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.Cann: A Netrunner cannot Jack In to their own token.

PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.Inte: The Interface rank for {actor} could not be read.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.Targ: The WILL value for {actor} could not be read.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.OutO: The target is outside the Jack-In range of {maximum} squares.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Item.Name: Quickhack
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Item.JackI: Quickhacking controls. Equip this item to Jack In to a targeted character or perform a Quickhack from the Fight tab.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Item.Creat: Pneuma's Quickhack Items are installed in the Items directory.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Item.Effec: Reduces the target's MOVE by 1 for 60 seconds.
Temporarily deafens the target and gives them the Damaged Ear Critical Injury without its bonus damage.
Sets the target on fire, dealing 4 direct HP damage after each of their Turns until extinguished.
Disables three eligible pieces of the target's cyberware for 60 seconds.
Disables one eligible piece of cyberware and its attached options for 60 seconds.
Creates a phantom noise that draws the target's next Move Action toward it.
Reduces the target's MOVE by 1d6 for 60 seconds.
Deals 3d6 damage directly to HP, ignoring armor.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Damage.Una: You are not authorized to roll damage for {actor}.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Damage.Inv: This Quickhack damage roll is no longer valid.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Item.Effec: Controls the target's Action and Move Action during their next Turn.
Ejects one installed piece of the target's chipware unless its slot is covered.
Leaves the target Unconscious and Prone for 60 seconds; damage can wake them early.
This phase resolves the Interface Check and target alert. Mechanical effects will be automated in the next phase.
{actor} does not possess any Quickhack Items.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Settings.R: When enabled, a Netrunner can select only Quickhack Items present in their character inventory. Items do not need to be equipped.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Settings.M: Configure messages by attacker and target type.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Settings.N: Jack-In and Quickhack attack rolls and results are always blind messages to GMs.
The Jack-In attack roll is always GM-blind. If the player does not detect it, only GMs receive the result.
The Quickhack attack roll is always GM-blind. The result always shows the Interface total, and the player becomes aware of the attack.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Settings.P: The attack roll is always public. Choose who sees whether the NPC becomes aware.
The attack roll and result are always public.
All Jack-In and Quickhack rolls and results are public.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Settings.Q: When the player detects the Jack-In, who sees the result?
Does the detected result show Interface and WILL totals?
Does the result identify the NPC attacker?
Who sees if the NPC target becomes aware?

PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.ForceOut.A: An active GM is required to resolve the Netrunner's hidden Interface roll.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Error.Conc: The defending character does not have a readable Concentration skill.

PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Effect.Res: The Quickhack result did not synchronize to the GM. Resolve its effect manually.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Effect.Req: The Quickhack effect request could not be validated.
PNEUMA_COMBAT_TOOLS.Quickhack.Effect.Sum: MOVE reduced by 1 for 60 seconds; restores automatically.
